inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> from <Picture 1>: The same adult blonde woman throughout, with shoulder-length blonde hair, narrow black sunglasses, gold hoop earrings, a small flower pendant, black blazer, black ribbed top and shoulder-bag strap. Complete the unseen lower outfit with consistent black trousers and boots. She carries one heavy greatsword specified by the user; red-gold liquid sword energy follows its actual blade path.
<Subject 2> from <Picture 2>: The same ruined suspended Eastern stone bridge above a cloud abyss, with broken rails, stone pillars, giant chains, cliffs and distant ancient buildings.
<Subject 3> from <Picture 3>: One bone-white insectile machine with cracked armor, black mechanical tissue, two scythe forelimbs, extra limbs, antennae, damaged wings and a warm-gold chest core.

summary:
[reference generation] A relentless, close-range 20-second duel on the suspended bridge. The woman survives successive upper, middle and lower scythe attacks, progressively damages one shoulder joint, opens the core guard and lands a final greatsword strike. Both fighters attack and counterattack continuously; every break in armor changes the next exchange.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — identity, hair, sunglasses and visible black clothing; new combat motion and the user-specified sword.
<Subject 2>: fully_preserved — one continuous bridge location and its architecture; accumulated damage remains.
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved — one consistent insectile machine, scythes, limbs, wings and gold core.

detailed_description:
Dark-fantasy CG with crisp silhouettes, aggressive camera movement and layered red-gold liquid blade trails against black-white mechanical energy. Fifteen rapid shots in 20 seconds; no pause, slow motion or frozen victory pose.
[Shot 1] The machine dives diagonally into the bridge. Both scythes cross toward the woman's head; she drives forward under them and catches their crossing point with her greatsword. A narrow white impact core bursts into two red-gold rings; the stone under both fighters cracks.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.300, a low lateral tracking shot follows her sword sliding down the left scythe. The machine jerks that blade free and stabs with the right; she turns her hips, beats the stab aside and answers with a short rising cut that chips its shoulder armor.
[Shot 3] At 00:02.600, over her shoulder, the machine pins her sword with both scythes while a third limb shoots beneath the bind. She twists the sword flat to catch it, steps outside the attack line and drives the pommel into the machine's faceplate; bone fragments spin away.
[Shot 4] At 00:03.900, a sharp reverse angle catches the machine recoiling only half a step before sweeping both scythes back. She ducks the first, meets the second edge-on, and her red-gold return slash carves a glowing groove through a bridge rail behind it.
[Shot 5] At 00:05.200, the falling rail becomes the foreground wipe. The machine springs through it, attacking high-low-high with scythe, tail and scythe. She parries high, hops the tail without levitating, and rotates directly into a downward block that drives sparks into the deck.
[Shot 6] At 00:06.500, close on boots and blade contact: the machine shoves her across loose stone; she digs in, shifts her grip and lets its pressure carry the greatsword around her shoulder. The returning edge strikes the already chipped joint; a thin gold fracture appears.
[Shot 7] At 00:07.800, a wider bridge-side shot shows the machine instantly answering with two stabbing limbs. She bats the first into a pillar and slides inside the second; the pillar breaks, while her horizontal sword arc forces the machine sideways rather than hitting its core.
[Shot 8] At 00:09.100, the camera follows its sideways skid. The machine hooks a scythe around her sword and yanks; she keeps both hands on the hilt, turns with the pull and shoulder-checks its center. Metal meets bone at close range; the core guard snaps shut.
[Shot 9] At 00:10.400, a brief overhead view clarifies their positions beside the cracked pillar. The machine attacks from above with both scythes while its tail cuts across her escape route. She blocks one, deflects the other into the tail, and escapes through the gap their collision creates.
[Shot 10] At 00:11.700, a fast side follow sees her launch three connected cuts—diagonal, horizontal, rising. The machine catches the first two with opposite scythes, but the third tears open the pre-fractured shoulder joint. White armor, black fluid-like energy and cold sparks separate in distinct layers.
[Shot 11] At 00:13.000, the machine compensates immediately, rotating its intact side forward and striking with a scythe-tail combination. She retreats only one step, catches the scythe on her sword spine and lets the tail break the stone where her foot had been.
[Shot 12] At 00:14.300, from behind the machine, she uses that broken stone as a springboard. Her sword comes down; the machine raises its intact scythe and redirects the blow into a chain anchor. The anchor cracks, the giant chain jerks, and both fighters adjust their footing as it swings.
[Shot 13] At 00:15.600, a tight orbit follows the renewed clash: scythe slash, sword catch, third-limb thrust, body turn, sword-back strike. The woman presses the broken shoulder side; the machine guards the chest with its remaining scythe, exposing the earlier fracture around the core.
[Shot 14] At 00:16.900, the machine surges forward with a gold-core pulse and two rapid cuts. She blocks the first, slips beneath the second and cuts across the damaged shoulder-to-chest seam. Red-gold liquid light travels through the real cut; the guard plates split open.
[Shot 15] At 00:18.300, the machine lunges once more. She turns its scythe off-line, plants both feet on the cracked deck and drives the unchanged greatsword into the exposed core housing. A narrow white flash expands into a red-gold ring and falling armor fragments; the machine collapses, its core dims, and the already-broken bridge keeps shedding stone into the clouds.

overall_soundscape:
Continuous steel-on-bone impacts, differentiated misses and contacts, boot scrapes, snapping stone, whipping chain and short electrical crackles. The final core strike has one deep impact followed by falling debris; no dialogue.
non_diegetic_music:
Fast dark orchestral percussion and low brass, with sharp rhythmic accents matching the exchanges; the score does not drown out the weapon contacts.

Constraints: no gore, dismemberment, extra characters, weapon changes, costume changes, location changes, UI, text, watermark, slow motion, idle staring, one-sided attacks, spatial resets or repaired scenery.
